dmTitle.infoName: Cargo Compartment Low Temperature Indication After a Cold Soak

faultDescr.para: CARGO TEMP LO displayed after a cold soak, clearing within twenty minutes of heating

The cargo compartment temperature indication reads well below the actual compartment temperature after an overnight cold soak, and normalises within about twenty minutes of the heating system running. The behaviour is repeatable on the same aircraft and absent on others in the same fleet. Where live animals are carried the indication forces the shipment to be refused at the gate, so the operational consequence is out of proportion to the technical fault. There is no correlation with compartment loading.
Flight deck effect: CARGO AFT TEMP LO, CARGO AFT HEAT FAULT.

row.entry: Moisture ingress at the vented transmitter body
Water in the transmitter connector from a harness drip loop above the connector
Heating loop actuator slow to drive from cold
Genuine loss of heating airflow to the compartment

reqCondNoRef.reqCond: The aircraft electrical power is available.

isolationStepQuestion.para: Record the compartment temperature indication, the ambient temperature and the time since the aircraft was last powered.

isolationStepAnswer.para: If this identifies the fault, the cause is: Moisture ingress at the vented transmitter body (9469HM).

isolationStepAnswer.correctiveAction: Go to the end of the procedure and do the confirmation task.

isolationStepQuestion.para: Measure the actual compartment temperature with a calibrated thermometer at the transmitter position.

isolationStepAnswer.para: If this identifies the fault, the cause is: Water in the transmitter connector from a harness drip loop above the connector (9469HM).

isolationStepAnswer.correctiveAction: Go to the end of the procedure and do the confirmation task.

isolationStepQuestion.para: If the two agree, the indication is correct and the fault is in the heating system; go to step 7.

isolationStepAnswer.para: If this identifies the fault, the cause is: Heating loop actuator slow to drive from cold (181HM).

isolationStepAnswer.correctiveAction: Go to the end of the procedure and do the confirmation task.

isolationStepQuestion.para: If the indication reads low, isolate the transmitter and measure its resistance at the connector.

isolationStepAnswer.para: If this identifies the fault, the cause is: Genuine loss of heating airflow to the compartment (181HM).

isolationStepAnswer.correctiveAction: Go to the end of the procedure and do the confirmation task.

isolationStepQuestion.para: Compare the resistance with the temperature reference table and record both values.

isolationStepAnswer.correctiveAction: Go to the end of the procedure and do the confirmation task.

isolationStepQuestion.para: Inspect the transmitter body and its connector for moisture, and check whether the vent is present on the installed transmitter standard.

isolationStepAnswer.correctiveAction: Go to the end of the procedure and do the confirmation task.

isolationStepQuestion.para: Do the confirmation task and record the stabilisation time.

isolationStepAnswer.correctiveAction: Go to the end of the procedure and do the confirmation task.

isolationStepQuestion.para: Check the loop actuator 181HM drive time and the solenoid 9469HM energisation against the values in the maintenance documentation.

isolationStepAnswer.correctiveAction: Go to the end of the procedure and do the confirmation task.

isolationStepQuestion.para: Where moisture is found at the transmitter vent or in the connector, dry the installation, re-seal the connector and repeat the confirmation task.

isolationStepAnswer.correctiveAction: Go to the end of the procedure and do the confirmation task.

isolationStepQuestion.para: Where the fault repeats after drying, replace the transmitter with the sealed standard and record the aircraft as modified.

isolationStepAnswer.correctiveAction: Go to the end of the procedure and do the confirmation task.

isolationProcedureEnd.para: Do the confirmation task AMM-M-21-40-11-700-016-A and make sure that the fault does not return.

reqCondNoRef.reqCond: Make sure that no fault message is shown and make an entry in the aircraft technical log.

correlatedFaultInfo.para: Dispatch is permitted with the cargo temperature indication inoperative provided no temperature-sensitive cargo is carried. Dispatch with the compartment heating itself inoperative is subject to the route and cargo restrictions of the master minimum equipment list.

entry.para: Cargo temperature indication inoperative, no temperature-sensitive cargo carried.
